summary: Lane County lookout in the Umpqua National Forest: a 1912 cabin, a 1936 tower, and the present 53-ft R-6 tower of 1972. Rental and current access are disputed.

facts.design: Present 53-ft timber tower with a one-room 15x15-ft R-6 cab

access.note: Forest Service page (updated 2026-08-10) lists overnight rental by reservation and marks the site open; Travel Oregon says temporarily closed for infrastructure repair; a 2026 visitor found the road gated.

visit.trail_note: The final road is steep, rocky and rough, and high-clearance vehicles are recommended. A 2026 visitor found the road gated and walked up.

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on the cupola date (1921 register and 1921 newspaper vs 1924 in two others), the 1936 tower height (20, 29 or 30 ft), and whether the tower is in the rental program (2015 removal per a 2026 blog vs rental until pulled for 2022 per a 2022 trip report vs an FS page offering overnight rental). Current access is unresolved: FS marks the site open with a rental, Travel Oregon says temporarily closed, and a 2026 visitor found the road gated. Staffing after 2024 is hearsay from a TikTok account, which also describes a few days of staffing in July 2025. Elevation differs across sources (NHLR 5,857 ft; Roaming Civic 5,933 ft; firelookout 5,933 ft); the brief's 1785.2 m matches NHLR. No source found on any fire spotted from the tower. The brief's built 1972 refers to the present tower; the first structure dates to 1912.
